name: Shepherd's Staff
descriptionTemplate: {Team Unique}: At battle start, the wielder gains Aliemus equal to [StateArg1]% of the wielder's Aliemus Regen. After the wielder releases Exalt for the first time in each battle, this effect repeats once.
lore:
Vast flocks of sheep wandered across endless grasslands.
There were countless sheep in the world, and sheep were born to be led by a shepherd.
She had always been the world's prophet, carrying the staff of Knowledge. She had always been a good shepherd, determined to lead her flock along the righteous path.
With that staff, she disciplined the lambs and drove away the wolves. She raised it high, for she could always foresee the road ahead.
Once, she had led her flock to abundant water and fresh pasture. Now that she had seen the truth of the world, she led them into its final embrace.

"This way. Don't look back."
She smiled and waved her staff of wisdom.
The sheep could not see the cliff ahead.

One by one, they fell.
The shepherd sang.

Follow the selfless shepherd, for she had shown you the truest path. Do not be afraid. Though you walked through the valley of the shadow of death, her staff remained with you.
Until you both stepped into the Abyss of Annihilation.
